$about: The app's own text in English, the source every other language's table translates. LOCALISATION.md says how keys and placeholders work.
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.General.Intro: Where your work goes, and what the app does when it starts.
Settings.General.ProjectsEmpty: Empty: {folder}. New Project still lets you put one anywhere.
Settings.General.ProjectsHere: New Project starts here, and still lets you put one anywhere.
Settings.General.ProjectsMissing: That folder doesn't exist yet. It's made when the first project goes in it.
Settings.General.ReopenProject: Open the last project again when the app starts
Settings.General.RecentCount: {count:N0} remembered: recent files, projects and Asset Browser files.
Settings.General.OutputFolder: Where extracted files go unless you choose
Settings.General.KeepStructure: Keep the game's folders under it
Settings.General.OpenWhenDone: Open the folder when extracting finishes
Settings.General.ExtractHint: The extract bar under the file list has these too, with the choices for one extraction (textures as PNG, CR2W as JSON).
Settings.General.Copies: Files more than one archive has
Settings.General.AskCopy: Ask which copy to open, when a mod or DLC has its own copy of a game file
Settings.General.AskCopyHint: Off, the Asset Browser opens the copy the game loads. The Asset Browser's Ask which copy button is the same choice.
Settings.Appearance.Intro: Changes show straight away. Cancel puts them back.
Settings.Appearance.ThemeHint: Accent and background colours. Windows uses your Windows accent colour and see-through window background; the others are named after the witcher schools.
Settings.Appearance.ThemeWindowsTip: Your Windows accent colour and window background
Settings.Game.Intro: Where the game, its settings and the other tools are. Each is found by itself when it can be; set one when it isn't, or to use another.
Settings.Game.GameFolderAbout: Where The Witcher 3 is installed: its bundles, scripts, mods and DLC. It's found in your Steam and GOG libraries when this is empty.
Settings.Game.GameFolderFindTip: Look for The Witcher 3 in your Steam and GOG libraries
Settings.Game.GameNotFound: Not set, and the game wasn't found in your Steam or GOG libraries. Set it to read the game's files and scripts.
Settings.Game.GameFoundUsed: Not set, so the one found is used: {folder}
Settings.Game.GameFound: Found the game's files and scripts.
Settings.Game.GameWrongFolder: This isn't The Witcher 3 folder. Choose the one that has the bin and content folders.
Settings.Game.GameMissing: It isn't in your Steam or GOG libraries. Use the folder button to pick it yourself.
Settings.Game.DocumentsAbout: Where the game keeps input.settings (key bindings), mods.settings (mod priorities) and scriptslog.txt. It's Documents\The Witcher 3 on Windows; set it when your game writes elsewhere, such as under Proton or Wine, or when Documents was moved.
Settings.Game.DocumentsDefaultTip: Empty the box, for Documents\The Witcher 3
Settings.Game.DocumentsNoSettings: The game hasn't written its settings there yet: start the game once, or choose where it writes them.
Settings.Game.DocumentsNotYet: {folder} doesn't exist yet: the game makes it the first time it runs.
Settings.Game.DocumentsPick: Choose the folder the game keeps its settings in
Settings.Game.WccAbout: REDkit's own tool, for compiling scripts the way publishing from REDkit does. REDkit's source files, found beside it, also fill in the properties cooking leaves out of the game's files.
Settings.Game.WccFindTip: Look for REDkit in your Steam and GOG libraries
Settings.Game.WccHint: REDkit is free on Steam and GOG for owners of the game. wcc_lite is in its bin\x64_RedKit folder.
Settings.Game.WccNotSetBuiltIn: Not set. Compile uses the built-in compiler, which reads the game's scripts.
Settings.Game.WccNotSetNoScripts: Not set, and the game's scripts weren't found, so Compile is off. Scripts can still be edited and saved.
Settings.Game.WccFound: Found wcc_lite and REDkit's game scripts.
Settings.Game.WccNoScripts: That's wcc_lite, but REDkit's r4data\scripts folder isn't two folders up from it, where it's expected.
Settings.Game.WccWrongFile: Choose wcc_lite.exe in REDkit's bin\x64_RedKit folder.
Settings.Game.WccMissing: It isn't in your Steam or GOG libraries. Use the folder button to pick wcc_lite.exe yourself.
Settings.Game.MergerAbout: Script Merger Remastered by relapse12, which merges mods that change the same scripts or files. The load order analyser suggests it for clashes and opens it from a button.
Settings.Game.MergerFindTip: Look in the game folder, Documents and Downloads
Settings.Game.MergerHint: It's a separate download (nexusmods.com/witcher3/mods/13076). This app only starts it; it doesn't bundle or change it.
Settings.Game.MergerNotSet: Not set. The load order analyser still works; it just can't open the merger for you.
Settings.Game.MergerWrongFile: That isn't a program. Choose the merger's .exe.
Settings.Game.MergerMissing: It isn't in the game folder, Documents or Downloads. Use the folder button to pick its .exe yourself.
Settings.Language.Intro: The language of the app, and the language of the game's text and voices the viewers start in.
Settings.Language.AppWindowsTip: The language Windows shows, when the app has it, else English
Settings.Language.AppStatusWindows: Windows shows {windows}, so the app is in {language}.
Settings.Language.Pseudo: Pseudo-locale, for testing: English accented and lengthened, to find text that isn't localised and layouts that clip
Settings.Language.AppHint: Windows, menus and messages change as soon as you save. Text a window has already filled in changes when it's opened again or the app restarts. The guide (F1) shows the pages translated into your language and the rest in English.
Settings.Language.GameIntro: The language of the game's text and voices the viewers start in. Each viewer's own language list can still change it for a while.
Settings.Language.GameNotFound: The game wasn't found, so it can't be said which languages it has.
Settings.Language.HasAll: Your game has {language} text and voices.
Settings.Language.HasTextOnly: Your game has {language} text, and no {language} voices: scenes use the English voices.
Settings.Language.HasVoicesOnly: Your game has {language} voices but not its text: lines show in English.
Settings.Language.HasNone: Your game hasn't {language} installed: lines and voices show in English. Steam and GOG install other languages from the game's properties.
Settings.Language.UsedForScenes: •  Scenes: their lines and subtitles, and the voices, which are English where a language has none.
Settings.Language.UsedForCutscenes: •  Cutscenes: their lines. Their voices stay English, as the animation and lip sync are timed to them.
Settings.Language.UsedForStrings: •  The game strings search, and the strings editor when a file doesn't say its language.
Settings.Scripts.Intro: How scripts are compiled, how files open, and how the code editors look and help.
Settings.Scripts.CompilerAuto: wcc_lite when it's set, else the built-in compiler
Settings.Scripts.CompilerHint: The built-in compiler takes a second and needs only the game's scripts. wcc_lite takes about a minute and is the game's own, so use it for a release. Both write the same precompiled.rsblob.
Settings.Scripts.WillUseBuiltIn: Compile will use the built-in compiler.
Settings.Scripts.WillUseNeither: Neither compiler can run: the game's scripts weren't found. Set the game folder under Game and tools.
Settings.Scripts.OpenHint: For the files that open in the preview window, such as text and strings. Scripts always open in Script Bench. A file that's open already is brought forward instead of opening twice.
Settings.Scripts.EditorsHint: For scripts, XML and stubs. The game's own scripts are indented with tabs, so the tab width is how far in their code sits. JSON keeps its two spaces.
Settings.Scripts.Peek: Show a name's declaration when the mouse rests on it in a script
Settings.Scripts.Complete: Suggest names while typing in a script (Ctrl+Space suggests them any time)
Settings.Viewers.Intro: What the viewers read, and how much detail the 3D views load.
Settings.Viewers.RedkitProps: Read them from REDkit's source files when REDkit has one
Settings.Viewers.RedkitPropsHint: Cooking leaves out what the game doesn't need to run, such as defaults and editor notes, which REDkit's source copies keep. Off, the viewers show the game's cooked file only, exactly as the game reads it. A mod's or your project's files always show their own.
Settings.Viewers.RedkitMissing: REDkit isn't installed or found, so the viewers show the game's cooked files either way.
Settings.Viewers.TextureDetailHint: The largest a texture is read for entities, scenes, cutscenes, rigs and animations. Higher is sharper close up but slower to load, and a scene with many actors uses much more memory. Medium suits most. Viewers open already keep what they've read; it applies to those opened next.
Settings.Privacy.Intro: The app works offline and collects nothing about you. This is the one thing that can go online, and only when you turn it on.
Settings.Privacy.EabAbout: EasyAssetBrowser's community categories and tags for the game's files, shown in the Asset Browser. They're downloaded from its GitHub repository about once a day, which GitHub sees as any download. Nothing is sent.
Settings.Privacy.EabForget: Turn off and delete what it downloaded
Settings.Privacy.EabOn: On: the Asset Browser shows its categories and tags.
Settings.Privacy.EabOnSince: On since {date:d MMMM yyyy}: the Asset Browser shows its categories and tags.
Settings.Privacy.EabOff: Off: the app doesn't go online at all.
Settings.Privacy.SettingsFile: Your settings are kept in %AppData%\W3ModWorkbench\settings.json, on this computer only.
Settings.Privacy.NoticesMissing: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md is missing from the app folder.
Settings.Privacy.PrivacyMissing: PRIVACY.md is missing from the app folder.
Settings.Privacy.PrivacySummary: W3 Mod Workbench collects no information about you. It works offline and goes online only for EasyAssetBrowser tags, which are off until you turn them on: it then downloads their lists from GitHub, which sees your IP address as with any download.
